sources_read: mig_huggingface_huggingface_hub.md (v1.0 guide, context only, out of range)

candidates.description: snapshot_download raises IncompleteSnapshotError instead of returning a partial cached folder when the Hub is unreachable and files are missing.
candidates.source_quote: `snapshot_download` now raises `IncompleteSnapshotError` instead of silently returning a partial folder.

candidates.description: filter_repo_objects allow/ignore pattern matching became case-sensitive on all platforms (changes Windows behaviour).
candidates.source_quote: `allow_patterns`/`ignore_patterns` now match case-sensitively on every OS (aligned with case-sensitive Hub paths).

candidates.description: Six inference providers were dropped from the accepted provider values of InferenceClient.
candidates.source_quote: removes six providers no longer routed by the Hub (`black-forest-labs`, `clarifai`, `hyperbolic`, `nebius`, `nvidia`, `sambanova`)

candidates.description: The constant INFERENCE_ENDPOINT_IMAGE_KEYS was deleted from huggingface_hub.constants.
load_state_dict_from_file now loads safely by default (safe=True) and its pickle path defaults to weights_only=True.
candidates.source_quote: `load_state_dict_from_file` now defaults to `safe=True` (always using the safetensors loader), the pickle path defaults to `weights_only=True`

candidates.description: create_inference_endpoint keeps the account_id keyword but ignores it (FutureWarning); PrivateLink settings moved to new parameters.
candidates.source_quote: The legacy `account_id` keyword still exists but is ignored and emits a `FutureWarning`

candidates.description: The HTTP dependency moved from httpx/httpcore to httpx2/httpcore2: client factories, sessions and transport exceptions now use httpx2 types.
candidates.source_quote: clients and transport exceptions now come from `httpx2`/`httpcore2` instead of `httpx`/`httpcore`.

candidates.description: upload_large_folder (function and HfApi method) was removed; use upload_folder.
duplicate_space was removed in favour of duplicate_repo.
request_space_storage was removed; Space volumes APIs replace it.
delete_space_storage was removed; Space volumes APIs replace it.
repo_type_and_id_from_hf_id was removed; parse_hf_uri replaces it.
The PROTECTED member of InferenceEndpointType was removed; type='protected' now raises ValueError.
list_models lost its model_name parameter; use search.
create_repo lost its space_storage parameter; use space_volumes.
duplicate_repo lost its space_storage parameter; use space_volumes.
text_generation lost its stop_sequences parameter; use stop.
InferenceClient no longer accepts a boolean token (token=True was a deprecated way to use the saved token).
candidates.source_quote: Boolean `InferenceClient(token=...)` → pass a token string or `None`
